keys.causal_role: offset ready pose owns a low rear tool line before the vertical task
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root is stable around x18 with weight already biased toward rear/left leg; tool lives behind the travel line.
keys.name: CANTED_READY

keys.causal_role: deep asymmetric coil loads rear hip while tool counterloads farther behind
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Pelvis drops left/down; rear hip and both supports carry the body while the tool's mass line moves opposite future travel.
keys.name: CROSSLOAD

keys.causal_role: rear support drives upward-right while tool remains delayed
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root rises/right from left-dominant support; lead/right foot is light and tool still points back/down.
keys.name: REAR_DRIVE

keys.causal_role: support break commits root before the tool task begins
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Both supports leave only after rear-drive prep; root rises right while the tool still trails below the pelvis.
keys.name: SHEAR_RELEASE

keys.causal_role: fast rise stretches root-to-foot line while rear task mass lags
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root climbs sharply right; legs lengthen on different diagonals and tool remains behind to expose launch acceleration.
keys.name: RISE_LONG

keys.causal_role: body begins an off-axis task while root is still rising
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root continues right/up; right shoulder opens and tool begins to swing around the torso without changing support or injecting a new root impulse.
keys.name: TASK_COCK

keys.causal_role: tool crosses above and left of the body at apex while torso counter-rolls right
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root keeps drifting right through apex; the task line sweeps across the upper body to the left while torso/hips counter-roll, creating local torque without a second root impulse.
keys.name: APEX_CROSSCUT

keys.causal_role: task commits past the root line and stores rotational debt in shoulders/hips
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root begins descending right; tool sweeps forward/down while pelvis and legs counter-scissor instead of following the tool.
keys.name: TASK_FOLLOWTHROUGH

keys.causal_role: forward tool mass becomes counterweight while body prepares to catch
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root descends more quickly; torso sits behind the tool line, lead leg lengthens down, rear leg folds and the tool remains forward.
keys.name: DESCENT_COUNTERWEIGHT

keys.causal_role: lead foot probes while tool and rear limb remain airborne
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Lead/left foot reaches groundward under the root; tool is still forward and cannot secretly become support.
keys.name: PRECONTACT_SPEAR

keys.causal_role: first contact transfers support before downward COM is paid
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Left foot acquires ground while pelvis keeps moving down/right; tool is still ahead and begins to lag relative to the catching body.
keys.name: LEAD_CATCH

keys.causal_role: lead leg yields while trail leg races under the falling center
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root continues down/right over the left support; rear/right knee folds under and tool stops advancing, creating visible task lag.
keys.name: TRAIL_FOLD_UNDER

keys.causal_role: both supports own a deep asymmetric crush that pays vertical and rotational debt
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root bottoms after trail foot joins; torso counterleans left while tool crosses low/right, making landing consequence larger than contact.
keys.name: TWO_FOOT_CRUSH

keys.causal_role: landing force becomes a grounded step-through instead of a reset
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root rises slightly and travels right over new support; right leg takes ownership while left leg releases, tool is still late.
keys.name: RIGHT_RUNOUT

keys.causal_role: body catches first; tool inertia overshoots behind and below the shoulder
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root continues a short grounded rightward runout while tool reverses late behind the body; upper task debt is now visibly separate from root debt.
keys.name: TOOL_OVERSHOOT_BACK

keys.causal_role: grounded rebound restores height unevenly while the tool remains low and late
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root rises without returning left; knees extend at different rates and right shoulder stays lower because tool debt is unresolved.
keys.name: CROOKED_REBOUND

keys.causal_role: delayed shoulder and hand recover after lower body has already stabilized
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Pelvis is nearly settled at displaced address; right shoulder and tool climb later than left side, preserving secondary lag.
keys.name: SHOULDER_PAYBACK

keys.causal_role: whole body restacks at a new root address with residual asymmetry
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root stabilizes well right of launch; support is both feet but tool remains canted rather than returning to the original pose.
keys.name: OFFSET_RESTACK

keys.causal_role: recovery exits into a forward task-ready step rather than idle reset
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root advances one final increment; right support owns the next action while tool lifts to a new ready line, not the starting line.
keys.name: TASK_REENTRY_STEP

noodle_queen.taste_function_contempt: PASS: the apex crosscut, lead-catch/deep-crush landing, and delayed tool overshoot form memorable silhouette phases; task/root causality remains readable; recovery is displaced and indebted rather than an idle reset; the specimen does not read as placeholder endpoint motion.

tango.final_read: PASS: asymmetrical crossload -> earned release -> long rise -> visible cross-body apex tool sweep -> gravity-owned counterweighted descent -> unsupported lead probe -> first-contact-with-continuing-COM -> deep two-foot crush -> grounded right runout -> delayed tool overshoot back -> crooked rebound -> shoulder payback -> displaced task re-entry.
